items.name: Finnish FMC Series I 2025
items.information:
**This is an FMC only competition. No speedsolving events will be held.**
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor.

**Tämän kisan ainoa laji on vähiten siirtoja. Speedsolving -lajeja ei pidetä.**
Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.

items.name: A New Year in Auckland 2025

venue.name: Every Nation Auckland City
venue.address: 9 Karaka Street, Eden Terrace, Auckland 1010, New Zealand

items.information:
A New Year in Auckland 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.
​
This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.
​
Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.
​
